notes.title: Dream Girlfriend: Trad Girl — Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

We’re excited to announce our new game [b][i]Dream Girlfriend: Trad Girl[/i][/b]! 🌼 A visual novel about love, change, and second chances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698129/105dc82ba422dbf83c5a256fdea8b745b26da15f.png[/img]

Leon is a young man stuck in a world of temptations. Parties, casual affairs, and fleeting pleasures seem like sources of happiness to him, but beneath this bright facade lies only emptiness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698129/8f215fe1de4625d6ac0149f44f5d3e1bcd64bf3b.png[/img]

One day he meets Agnes, a girl whose innocence and kindness enchant him. Her view of the world, her beliefs, which seem so naive and pure, make him reflect on his own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698129/f1e4bb59605a242f41f31673b1d709d977dc0c77.png[/img]

Will he be able to leave his old life behind and start a new chapter with Agnes? Or will everything remain the same?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698129/1053e32ba86106c8f993bf04e9a836740cb0128c.png[/img]

[b]🌼 Wishlist Now 🌼[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407810/
